images.caption: A DEC AlphaStation 600A — the class of Alpha workstation Windows NT targeted through the 1990s, before Compaq ended the port in 1999.
An AlphaStation 500/400, one generation of the desktop Alpha hardware Windows NT and Windows 2000 RC2 were built and tested against.

images.caption: A Digital AlphaStation 200 4/233 — an entry-level Alpha workstation from the same NT-on-Alpha era, preserved and shown at a vintage computer fair.

images.caption: The Alpha 21164 processor: DEC's out-of-order successor chip, the family whose 21264 revision the Windows 2000 RC2 dxdiag panel names outright.
